# luna-pruner

> Claude Code plugin that cuts token cost: a context-size meter that suggests /compact or /clear, a local cost audit, and pruning of noisy tool output (build logs, directory listings, web pages, MCP responses) from the context window before Claude reads it. Uses OpenAI's Decisions API (gpt-6-luna) to score chunk relevance; plain code removes low-relevance chunks and leaves a marker pointing to the saved original. Zero dependencies, Node 18+, MIT.

Key facts: PostToolUse hook returning updatedToolOutput; UserPromptSubmit hook suggesting /compact; fail-open on errors; secrets are never sent; cannot edit old history (Claude Code hooks cannot).

- [README](https://github.com/luancamara/luna-pruner/blob/main/README.md): install, FAQ, limits
- [Findings with measurements (what saves tokens, what does not, RTK, Caveman)](https://github.com/luancamara/luna-pruner/blob/main/docs/findings.md)
- Stats: native panel `/luna-stats` (mod API), shell `luna-stats`, fallback `/luna-pruner:luna-stats`: spent on Luna vs saved, in tokens, USD and BRL
- [How it works](https://github.com/luancamara/luna-pruner/blob/main/docs/how-it-works.md): pipeline and tuning
- [Contributing](https://github.com/luancamara/luna-pruner/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security and data flow](https://github.com/luancamara/luna-pruner/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
